items.title: CMU highlights its robotics presence at IROS 2026 in Pittsburgh
items.summary_en: According to search-result excerpts of CMU's story, Pittsburgh hosted IROS 2026 from Sept. 27 to Oct. 3. Roughly 300 members of the CMU community attended, and CMU researchers presented about 180 papers and organized workshops.
items.notes: ri.cmu.edu blocked; facts from search excerpt only; conference coverage, not a research result. Mirror: https://www.cmu.edu/news/stories/archives/2026/september/global-conference-in-pittsburgh-puts-carnegie-mellons-robotics-leadership-in-the-spotlight

items.title: RI Pathways Fellowship begins its fourth year
items.summary_en: Per the search excerpt, the CMU Robotics Institute Pathways Fellowship, run with InnovatePGH, began its fourth year on Sept. 15, 2026, with a cohort of seven aspiring engineers, designers and entrepreneurs.
items.notes: Search excerpt only; likely outside window and low relevance to frontier AI.
